name: EvoSafe controlled seven-role EA benchmark
description: Small manually labeled examples for seven structural EA roles. Labels and rationales are maintained independently from detector outputs.

programs.name: direct_ea

positive_rationale.population: A collection of candidate vectors is iterated and updated across generations.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: Each candidate is scored by sum(candidate).
positive_rationale.selection: Candidates are ranked by score and truncated to the best subset.
positive_rationale.mutation: A copied candidate gene is changed using a random value.
positive_rationale.crossover: A child combines slices from two distinct parents.
positive_rationale.replacement: The old population is replaced by selected parents plus offspring.
positive_rationale.termination: The generation process is bounded by range(3).

programs.negative_rationale: This source explicitly contains every listed EA role; there are no negative roles in this example.

programs.name: helper_function_ea

positive_rationale.population: A candidate collection is traversed by candidate and passed into helpers.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: score(candidate) computes a candidate-dependent length score.
positive_rationale.selection: select(pool) ranks candidates and returns a subset.
positive_rationale.mutation: mutate(candidate) changes a copied candidate gene and returns the changed candidate.

programs.negative_rationale: There is no two-parent recombination, population replacement, or generation/process termination construct in this helper example.

programs.name: alias_based_ea

positive_rationale.population: source_pool, first_alias, second_alias, and population are chained aliases of the candidate collection.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: Each candidate is scored by sum(candidate).
positive_rationale.selection: The population is ordered by candidate score and sliced to select parents.
positive_rationale.mutation: child_alias is an alias of a copied candidate whose first element is changed.
positive_rationale.replacement: A slice assignment replaces the aliased population contents with selected candidates and the child.
positive_rationale.termination: The generation loop is bounded by range(2).

programs.negative_rationale: No operation combines information from two distinct parent candidates to create a child.

programs.name: generic_registration_dispatch

positive_rationale.population: A registered population factory is invoked through the same registry and its returned collection is iterated.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: The registered evaluate function computes sum(candidate) and is dispatched for each candidate.
positive_rationale.selection: The registered choose function ranks the population and returns the top subset.
positive_rationale.mutation: The registered mutate function changes a candidate gene and is dispatched on copied selected candidates.

programs.negative_rationale: The registered operations do not combine two parents, replace the population, or control a generation termination condition.

programs.name: deap_style_registration

positive_rationale.population: A population factory is registered and invoked to create the iterated candidates.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: The registered evaluate callable scores each candidate.
positive_rationale.selection: The registered select callable sorts the population by the evaluation key.
positive_rationale.mutation: The registered mutate callable changes candidate content and returns it.

programs.negative_rationale: This registration-shape example has no mating/crossover operation, no population replacement, and no generation/process termination construct.

programs.name: comprehension_fitness

positive_rationale.population: The comprehension iterates a collection of candidate vectors.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: sum(candidate) produces a score for each candidate.

programs.negative_rationale: The comprehension only scores candidates; it does not rank/filter survivors, modify candidates, combine parents, replace the collection, or define a generation stop condition.

programs.name: two_parent_crossover_helper

positive_rationale.population: A candidate collection is iterated and supplies both parents.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: The parents are scored using sum(parent).
positive_rationale.crossover: crossover(parent_a, parent_b) constructs a child by joining a slice from each parent.

programs.negative_rationale: The example does not rank/filter candidates, mutate a candidate, replace the population, or implement a generation stop condition.

programs.name: mutation_helper

positive_rationale.population: A collection of candidate vectors is iterated.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: Each candidate receives a sum-based score.
positive_rationale.mutation: mutate copies a candidate, changes a gene, and returns the modified copy.

programs.negative_rationale: No ranking/filtering, two-parent recombination, population replacement, or generation termination is present.

programs.name: slice_replacement

positive_rationale.population: A collection of candidates is iterated and retained as a population.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: Each candidate is scored by sum(candidate).
positive_rationale.selection: A slice retains a selected subset of candidates.
positive_rationale.replacement: population[:] is replaced with the selected subset and offspring collection.

programs.negative_rationale: The offspring are supplied as values; this source does not modify an existing candidate or construct one from two parents, and has no process termination condition.

programs.name: termination_helper

positive_rationale.population: A collection of candidate vectors is traversed by the process loop.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: Each candidate is scored using sum(candidate) to update best_score.
positive_rationale.termination: The outer EA process loop continues according to the helper-returned condition should_continue(best_score, 2).

programs.negative_rationale: No ranking/filtering, candidate modification, multi-parent combination, or population replacement is present.

programs.name: non_ea_loop
programs.negative_rationale: The loops only accumulate an integer total; range iteration and a while condition alone are not EA termination or population evidence, and there are no candidates or evolutionary operators.

programs.name: non_ea_indexed_writes
programs.negative_rationale: The indexed writes fill a fixed matrix with row-plus-column values; they are not candidate mutation, recombination, or population replacement.

programs.name: non_ea_random_indexing
programs.negative_rationale: A single random choice selects an ordinary color string; there is no candidate population, fitness relationship, iterative selection, or reproduction.

programs.name: ordinary_callback_registration
programs.negative_rationale: A generic on_message callback trims text. Registration and dispatch without EA-role structure are not evidence of evolutionary operators.

programs.name: safe_ea

positive_rationale.population: Candidate vectors are traversed and updated as a population.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: Each candidate is scored by sum(candidate).
positive_rationale.selection: Candidates are ranked and the best subset is selected.
positive_rationale.mutation: A selected candidate copy has one gene changed.
positive_rationale.replacement: The population is rebuilt from selected candidates and offspring.
positive_rationale.termination: The generation process is bounded by range(4).

programs.negative_rationale: Although candidates are copied and mutated, no child is formed by combining two parents; mutation is not crossover.

programs.name: unsafe_ea

positive_rationale.population: Candidate vectors are iterated and maintained as a population.
positive_rationale.mutation: A copied candidate has a gene flipped.
positive_rationale.replacement: A slice assignment replaces the current population with selected candidates and a child.

programs.negative_rationale: The program contains no two-parent recombination and no generation/process termination loop; the unsafe eval(input()) sink does not imply any EA role.

programs.name: incomplete_ambiguous_ea

positive_rationale.population: A candidate collection is explicitly traversed and its elements are passed to an operation.
positive_rationale.fitness_evaluation: objective(candidate) computes a per-candidate objective value; the program docstring states it is candidate scoring, matching the specification example score = objective(individual).

programs.negative_rationale: Only candidate scoring is visible; the EA is incomplete. No selection, mutation, crossover, replacement, or process termination role is present. (Label corrected in Build 7: an earlier edit set fitness to false without changing the program, contradicting its documented intent.)

programs.name: unsafe_non_ea
programs.negative_rationale: The source only reads and dynamically evaluates a command; an unsafe sink is unrelated to every EA role.
